name: WhitePanel-UI
changelog: Separated UI assets into css/ and js/ (index, login, sub), persisted scanner/SNI results, automatic expiry and traffic enforcement for Xray users, fully configurable inbound client options (SNI, fingerprint, ALPN, host, flow, advanced JSON), configurable config name prefix (default White-), bundled scanner seed lists, and a custom use-and-share LICENSE (no modification, no selling).
